description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging functionalities, acting as an interface and wrapper around Android's native Log class. It manages log levels, log nodes, and provides various static methods for different log levels and message formatting.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging, acting as a wrapper around Android's Log utility, and managing a chain of LogNodes for flexible log handling.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode, which is the start of the linked list of log handlers.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which logs are forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log messages to the current LogNode, specifying priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert-level message with optional Throwable.
